findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/review-run.ts:483 WHY validateRunWorkspaceBinding verifies workspaceBinding against itself and checks that signedWorkspaceRoot is still a usable git root, but it never re-resolves the story current signed workspace from metadataRoot/config. In split-root wrapper projects, changing gitRoot after review_run_start can leave existing pass/finding evidence valid against the old repo while story_resolve/review_run_start now point at a different signedWorkspaceRoot. That violates the intended start/consumer consistency and can let REVIEW pass on the wrong material root.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bb40aada: validateRunWorkspaceBinding now re-resolves the current story signed workspace from metadataRoot/config and rejects stale review runs whose workspaceBinding no longer matches the current metadataRoot, signedWorkspaceRoot, repoRoot, or workspaceMode. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke and lattice validate --story=B-b750 --json.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.ts:740: WHY CHK-003 claims local reviewer evidence is never reported as Authority Server receipt-backed completion, but the configured gitRoot/local review_run_start path only asserts workspaceBinding fields and a local review_pass_set succeeds; neither this smoke nor scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs exercises absence of authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/receiptVerified or authority-receipt artifacts after local REVIEW evidence, so the Non-authority/Authority boundary remains untested.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bb40aada: field regression coverage now mechanically asserts local review evidence and process facts do not contain Authority completion claims such as authorityDone, fullAuthorityDone, receiptVerified, productionDone, or authority receipt artifacts. Process-fact contract updated to keep workspace binding as local REVIEW evidence only. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/core/story-signed-workspace-resolution.ts:63 resolves story.worktree.path after only proving the path is a git worktree; it never checks that the worktree is on story.worktree.branch or story/<storyId>. A stale or tampered story worktree record can therefore make review_run_start sign HEAD/materialHash from an unrelated branch, defeating the signed workspace binding this story is adding.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in bb40aada: persisted story.worktree.path resolution now verifies the worktree branch against story.worktree.branch / story/<storyId> before trusting it; branch-mismatched paths are rejected/fall through to valid linked story branch worktree resolution. Verified by npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke and lattice validate --story=B-b750 --json.
